results.title: Uniform rank diagnostics over finite local rings
results.question: Give a bit-polynomial algorithm for inner rank over F_q[x,y]/(x,y)^s when q and s vary and the ring is presented using the graded basis. Alternatively establish a precise hardness classification.
results.result: Exact polynomial-time inner rank via the normal rank of a residual pencil.

results.title: Positive-characteristic monomial tensor ranks
results.question: Can ordinary ranks of monomial tensors be classified uniformly when the field characteristic divides some relevant multinomial coefficients?
results.result: Exact ordinary and symmetric ranks for binary divided-power monomials, including the inseparable balanced exception.

results.title: Generic rank over finite fields
results.question: Can finite-field tensor-rank distributions be determined asymptotically uniformly when both mode dimensions and field size grow?
results.result: Tensor rank matches flattening rank, with polynomial-time optimal decomposition with high probability.

results.title: Matrix-space equivalence for bounded Kronecker defect
results.question: Obtain f(k) poly(N,log q) equivalence algorithms when the space differs from a matrix pencil by k independent generators.
results.result: Polynomial bit-time equivalence for matrix spaces with a marked split simple pencil and an arbitrary remainder.

results.title: Isotropic-subspace search in alternating matrix spaces
results.question: For arbitrary alternating spaces, compute a maximum common totally isotropic subspace in subexponential time improving unrestricted exhaustive search, with rigorous field-size dependence.
results.result: Exact common isotropic search parameterized by independence number of the coordinate anchors.

results.title: Partial projective equivalence with prescribed coordinates
results.question: Given two spanning multisets in PG(k−1,q) and a partial coordinate correspondence, find an FPT test in the number of unmatched projective dimensions, even when the supplied correspondence spans no canonical complement.
results.result: Exact projective multiset transport with a pinned marked span and no prescribed complement.
results.scope: quotient map enumeration over finite fields
results.verification: written proof with two Lean-checked identities

results.title: Epimorphism with a prescribed noncentral normal image
results.question: Given A normal in G and B normal in H, test whether some onto map sends A exactly onto B. Find a polynomial algorithm when B is abelian but may be noncentral and arbitrary quotient maps are allowed.
results.result: Exact counting and construction of epimorphic lifts for semisimple elementary abelian images in nonsplit extensions.
results.scope: specified quotient map or bounded quotient order

results.title: Counting epimorphic lifts across noncentral modular layers
results.question: Count lifts of a specified epimorphism on quotients through two elementary abelian normal layers with nonsemisimple common-prime action and no bound on top multiplicity.
results.result: Exact epimorphic lift counts with unbounded multiplicities of nonsimple modules.
results.scope: split targets with simple tops and nested restriction spaces

results.title: Normalization of marked diagonal subgroups
results.question: Determine parameterized complexity of finding a normalizer in a direct product of primitive actions when a list of overlapping simple diagonal factors must be preserved individually.
results.result: Exact transporter and normalizer generators for overlapping full simple diagonals.
results.scope: displayed normal simple subgroups with table embeddings

results.title: FPT coset intersection by nonabelian chief multiplicity
results.question: Parameterize intersection of two permutation cosets by the largest multiplicity of equivalent nonabelian chief factors in the generated group. Prove a uniform FPT algorithm or hardness under parameter-preserving reductions.
results.result: Coset intersection is GI-hard with one nonabelian chief factor and GI-equivalent on the displayed family.

results.title: Polylog parallel subgroup intersection for compact nilpotent actions
results.question: Given generators of two nilpotent groups that are subgroups of a common nilpotent permutation group, develop a uniform NC algorithm for their intersection with explicit product normal forms.
results.result: Deterministic uniform NC subgroup intersection with product normal forms from compact permutation generators.
results.scope: ambient class two of odd prime exponent

results.title: Smallest transitive subgroup by order
results.question: Given a transitive action, determine the minimum order of a transitive subgroup and produce its generators. Classify parameterized complexity in the number of steps of an invariant block chain.
results.result: Finds a smallest transitive subgroup of a Cartesian action by optimizing over subdirect blocks.
results.scope: minimally transitive simple factors, FPT in maximum point stabilizer size

results.title: Frobenius root closure of constant-depth circuits
results.question: For fixed p, if a polynomial of degree at most d represented by a size-s constant-depth circuit over a perfect field is a p-th power, must its p-th root have size poly(s,d) at comparable depth?
results.result: Frobenius roots preserve polynomial-size constant-depth formulas at bounded interfaces.

results.title: Fixed-exponent ROABP root closure below the width
results.question: For a fixed d≥2, if g^d has width w in a specified ROABP order over a characteristic-zero field, is the width of g in that order polynomially bounded in w and the input degree?
results.result: Same-order ROABP width bound for power roots from prefix coefficient ranks.
results.scope: polynomial in degree at fixed input width

results.title: Efficient interpolation for sum-of-ROABP certificates
results.question: Does polynomial-size linear-coefficient IPS with a fixed number of ROABP summands in separately chosen orders admit feasible interpolation by general span programs?
results.result: Feasible span-program interpolation for linear IPS with polynomial joint ROABP interface size.

results.title: Succinct null-cone equations
results.question: Can polynomial-size arithmetic circuits encode null-cone-defining invariant families for arbitrary explicitly presented connected reductive actions over C?
results.result: Positive circuits give optimal monomial null-cone tests. Directed-flow weights have polynomial-size invariant circuit families.
results.scope: fixed-rank explicit enumeration, arbitrary-rank nonuniform circuits for flow weights

results.title: Unconditional NP upper bound for rational Hilbert Nullstellensatz
results.question: Place feasibility of rational polynomial systems in algebraically closed fields in NP unconditionally, with bit complexity measured in the input description.
results.result: Deterministic polynomial bit-time feasibility and one-sided randomized sparse radical membership for rational binomial ideals.

results.title: Babai's coherent-configuration Sims analogue
results.question: Bound the largest nontrivial valency of every primitive coherent configuration by a function of its smallest nontrivial valency.
results.result: Sharp factorial bound on largest orbital valency in terms of the minimum.

results.title: Reusing algebraic anchors across noisy graph queries
results.question: After polynomial preprocessing of a fixed graph with a certified separating adjacency algebra, decide and recover near-isomorphisms for repeatedly queried graphs with t edge edits in f(t) times input-access complexity.
results.result: Preprocessed degree anchors and signature alignment solve exact budgeted edge-edit alignment.

results.title: Diameter-six chromatic-symmetric reconstruction
results.question: Prove that all trees of diameter six are distinguished by their chromatic symmetric functions, including cores with repeated internal multiplicities.
results.result: The first two edge-cut layers of the chromatic symmetric function reconstruct separated diameter-six trees among all trees.
results.scope: separated branch sizes in the source

results.title: Quantum isomorphism on compact graphs
results.question: Decide whether quantum graph isomorphism is decidable when both input graphs are classically compact; if it is, determine whether polynomial time is possible.
results.result: Quantum isomorphism agrees with ordinary isomorphism for walk-refined homogeneous cells linked by matchings or their complements.

results.title: Quantum-symmetry threshold in sparse random graphs
results.question: Determine the p(n) threshold at which G(n,p) has no nonclassical quantum symmetry with high probability, separating isolated-component effects from genuine connected quantum symmetry.
results.result: Exact quantum-symmetry threshold, critical-window law, and residual quantum automorphism algebra.
results.scope: sparse transition and its dense complement
